failures.subject: Pre-commit npm validation and build
failures.summary: The connected GitHub interface supports repository reads and Git-object writes but not command execution, and the local execution container could not resolve github.com to check out the repository. Therefore `npm run validate:wake`, `npm run build:wake-exports`, and `npm run build` could not be executed locally before commit. The changed JSON was checked against the repository’s documented validator invariants before publication, and deployment status must be used as the available end-to-end build check.
